instructions: Sends push notifications to the user's phone and other devices through Pushover. send_notification needs only message and sender; leave out every other parameter the user does not ask for. Without device a notification reaches all of the user's devices, the phone included. Priority high is for something important, low for a quiet notification without sound, silent for no alert at all, emergency for an alarm that repeats until the user acknowledges it. check_emergency_receipt and cancel_emergency_notification act on the latest emergency notification unless you give a receipt. Pushover cannot schedule: every notification goes out at once.

send_notification.description: Send a push notification to the user's devices now. message and sender are required. Returns the request ID, and for emergency priority a receipt.

params.sender: Who sends it, shown first in the title: your own name. A session or project you work in may follow in parentheses, e.g. "Claude (shop backend)". At most 64 characters.
params.device: Only to reach one device and not the others: its name from list_devices (several joined with commas). Omit to reach all devices; a notification "to my phone" needs none.

check_emergency_receipt.description: Check whether an emergency notification was acknowledged or has expired: the latest one sent, or the one of receipt.

params.receipt: Receipt of the emergency notification; omit for the latest one sent.

cancel_emergency_notification.description: Stop the repeated alerts of an emergency notification: the latest one sent, the one of receipt, or all sent with tag.

params.receipt: Receipt of the emergency notification to stop; omit receipt and tag for the latest one sent.
params.tag: Stop every emergency notification sent with this tag.
